name: companion-for-kimai
description: A browser extension that enhances your Kimai time-tracking workflow.
author: Matheus Bastos (https://github.com/mblithium)

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'));const files=[...m.content_scripts[0].js,'src/background/worker.js','src/popup/popup.js','src/popup/focus.js','src/options/options.js','src/common/permissions.js','src/common/format.js','src/common/theme.js','scripts/build-zip.js','scripts/select-manifest.js','scripts/sync-manifests.js','scripts/check-sensitive.js','scripts/release-notes.js','tests/harness.js','tests/check-pages.js','tests/check-contrast.js'];files.forEach(f=>cp.execFileSync('node',['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'}));console.log('check ok:',files.length,'arquivos JS');" && node tests/check-pages.js && node tests/check-contrast.js && node scripts/check-sensitive.js
scripts.build: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/build-zip.js --target all --clean
